recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if a future publisher/build regression emits primitive extension elements whose base.path points to the primitive-specific extension path instead of Element.extension.
issue_request: FHIR-12180 was Published/Persuasive for DSTU2 and asked the build to correct primitive type profile ElementDefinition.base.path values. The explicit example was string.profile.xml where string.extension incorrectly listed base.path string.extension instead of Element.extension.
initial_application: Jira records svn revision 10025 as the application. In this Git history that is commit 82e1ca4af69d33f527a180c7bfa003e811feb4c0, whose subject names Tasks 12180, 12182, and 12179. The relevant ProfileGenerator.makeExtensionSlice hunk changed generated extension slice base paths from path + '.extension' to Element.extension.
additional_context: The old in-repo Java generator source has since moved out of this checkout, but current build inputs for datatypes and primitive types remain active in source/fhir.ini and source/datatypes/primitives.xml. Current build.fhir.org primitive profile JSON checks for string and the other primitive profile filenames showed base.path Element.extension for each primitive extension element. FHIR-12179 and FHIR-12182 were applied by the same historical commit but concern separate snapshot constraint and element.id issues, so they were not decided here.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The historical generator fix was applied, the current source inputs are in build scope, and current generated primitive profiles already match the requested base.path behavior.
